# Pinterest India

> > Pinterest India is a visual discovery and inspiration platform featuring diverse content from travel destinations like Cham Islands and Hoi An, anime art featuring Gojo Satoru and Tokyo Revengers, DIY crafts, fashion trends, and design resources.

This is the Indian localized version of Pinterest, offering a multilingual collection of pins spanning travel inspiration, anime and manga art, crochet patterns, logo design resources, hairstyle trends, and lifestyle content. The platform serves as a visual bookmarking tool where users discover and save creative ideas across numerous categories.

## Key Topics

- Visual Discovery & Inspiration
- Travel Destinations (Cham Islands, Hoi An, Vietnam)
- UNESCO Biosphere Reserves & Marine Parks
- Anime & Manga Art (Gojo Satoru, Tokyo Revengers, Bleach)
- Black & White Anime Drawings
- Logo Design & Branding
- Crochet Patterns & DIY Crafts
- Hairstyle Trends 2025
- Minimalist Design
- Stock Images (Shutterstock)
- Russian Language Content
- Memorial & Sympathy Graphics
- Web3 & Blockchain Technology
- Beauty Service Templates
- Wordmark Logos

## Anime & Manga Art

- [Чб Аниме Рисунки](https://in.pinterest.com/ideas/чб-аниме-рисунки/912463076083/): Black & white anime drawings collection featuring Gojo Satoru & Tokyo Revengers
- [Мини Рисункилегкие](https://in.pinterest.com/ideas/мини-рисункилегкие/951037555428/): Easy mini drawings and tiny doodles ideas collection
